name: Korean
modelReview: usage notes written in Korean 2026-11-13 by a writer told nothing of cron; answers, lexicon and hand-written rows by Claude Fable 5.2, parked that day after two schedule reads and four blind reads. Resumed 2026-11-19: four author passes against one adversarial schedule read of all 696 rows and three blind readers briefed only in Korean, each asked for every reading of each sentence. Renderer built 2026-11-19 by an agent that saw no other renderer and no held-out row: 153 of 153 held-out rows on the first judged run; one hard-case row was wrong and was corrected (five uneven times are a list). Audited the same day by an independent agent (2,748 descriptions against the answer key; the cross-language trap patterns): one misleading family repaired test-first (the ends of a day step under named months), about 45 hard-case rows added. Reading check 2026-11-19: 736 rows, 5,340 questions, three readers, 99.93% of answers right; the one question most readers got wrong («…9시 29분까지 1분마다, 그리고 오전 9시 45분», last in its list) was asked again alone and misread by no reader of either model; nothing was changed. Notes, one reader of three each: a year or month other than the first asked (five, on «매년 6월 1일», «매년 6월 27일», «2월 25일(윤년에는 26일)» and the two nearest-working-day brackets), «매월 말일 3일 전(31일까지 있는 달은 28일)» on the 27th of a 30-day month, and the gap in «0시 29분까지 1분마다, 그리고 0시 45분». Not read by blind fluency readers: the 102 forms the audit changed or introduced; the positive date arm of a union («1~14·16~31일의 홀수일에도»). Thin evidence: «짝수 시» and «홀수 시» (every second hour) rest on wiki prose and two blind readers who wrote them unprompted, and a few readers may hesitate over whether 0시 is even; a native reviewer should check them first. Taste calls by the orchestrating model (Claude Fable 5.2) are in the answers with their evidence.
